findings.mechanism: Missing donor is refused for smart/master only, not every non-plain system playlist. Matching by PID compares 101/102/103 bytes but not special-kind header at miph+0x238. A changed-kind synthetic target receives appended donor ordinary membership. Genuine native Podcasts headers (kind2561, nonplain, nonsmart) also pass with a donor-derived source missing that system definition.
findings.recommendation: Define an explicit ordinary-versus-system profile. Refuse missing donor definitions for all modeled system/master kinds. Compare complete understood system classification/rule signatures before appending memberships; preserve unsupported bytes or reject instead of guessing.
findings.native_claim: Native-shaped system profile is observed, but derived missing/changed definitions were not loaded in iTunes. No actual native data-loss claim.

conservation_checks.primary_references: Independent recursive record walk checks item mtph+0x18 against primary mith+0x10 and checks framing/counts. Uses production Container only for decryption/decompression.
conservation_checks.counts: Independent primary list count comparisons against hdfm big-endian and mfdh little-endian offsets 0x44/0x48/0x4c/0x54. List counts and record lengths independently traversed.
conservation_checks.retained_tracks: Entire serialized records byte-exact for every old retained track; no field/string/PID/local-reference rewrite.
conservation_checks.restored_track: Donor bytes may differ only at mith+0x10, +0xdc, +0x1e0, +0x1f4, all 4-byte known local fields. Donor track PID and text/location/opaque bytes preserved.
conservation_checks.master: Exactly one master and exact surviving/imported track membership. File and master persistent identities unchanged.
conservation_checks.playlists: All retained playlist IDs, order, header non-count bytes, and non-item metadata exact. Delete removes only matching direct items. Restore appends donor occurrence multiplicity, including duplicates, without reordering old items.
conservation_checks.item_identity: Retained raw items preserve localID/PID/creation-order-token independently. Restoration fresh IDs/tokens/PIDs checked disjoint from all old playlist item values. Public replacement generates new item identities; low-level identity-preserving permutation is a separate research control.
conservation_checks.auxiliary: Exact expected album/artist PID sets, typed-reference resolution, unchanged retained records, and new auxiliary bytes differing only at localID. Delete may GC only selected orphan dependencies. Native shared-aux 32->31 keeps all16 albums and4 artists.
conservation_checks.headers_and_opaque: Unchanged retained outer/mfdh/section/list/header bytes outside framing/counters; unaffected opaque sections byte-exact. Seven regions x four removed identity types x four encodings =112 conservative PID marker refusals; refused bytes and handles stay unchanged.
conservation_checks.unsupported_profiles: History section20, nonempty secondary13/14, extended stsh, unknown global514 rejected transactionally.

rejection_assessment.conservative: 112 opaque PID-marker refusals pass. Markers are not proven semantic references, so these may intentionally over-reject. Do not loosen the safety guard from these controls alone.
under_rejection: F1 known nested mtph track-reference survives deletion
rejection_assessment.unproven_scan_limit: An opaque uint32 matching local track ID survives unchanged; this proves PID scan is not a universal local-ref decoder, not that that integer was a semantic reference. No blanket rewrites attempted.

native_evidence.raw_visibility_difference_expected: 14 serialized vs7 COM-visible, or15 vs8; seven unrepresented nonplain system playlists are not a corruption finding. Master/ordinary coverage and visible membership were checked.

native_order_observation.interpretation: 031 -> 033 changes member order but shares zero item PIDs; no identity-preserving native reorder demonstrated. The raw report all(empty) value is vacuous.

resources.initial_launcher_measurement: run-01-resource.json measured the venv launcher, not the real Python working set; do not use it as the true audit peak. V2 and supplement instrument actual Python.

limitations: synthetic nested shape is not demonstrated in native snapshots; refusal is safer than guessing grouped semantics
markers in opaque bytes are conservative rejection controls, not proof of real references
raw low-level identity-preserving permutation is not an implemented high-level reorder API
native candidate acceptance remains untested; no cross-library/new-media support certified
Native 031->033 item identity sets differ; do not infer identity preservation from order changes.
Reuse of pinned synthetic builders and Container means fixture construction/crypto are not independent reimplementations.
Only the existing bounded same-lineage WAV restore/delete API was exercised; future cross-library/new-media gates remain prospective.
future_import_invariants: Never alter any old track or retained playlist item identity/field/order without explicit operation semantics.
Resolve every known typed track, auxiliary and membership reference; reject unmodeled grouped/history/system dependencies.
Allocate destination local IDs and item identities without collisions while keeping track identity policy explicit across libraries.
Preserve master/file identities and full old+new track/field/location sets through two native saves/restarts with no fallback.
Keep public member replacement semantics separate from an identity-preserving reorder feature.
Do not treat COM visibility exclusions, pooled atom IDs, order tokens or opaque integer matches as interchangeable namespaces.
